target: Official final regular-season game margins, including technical free throws
primary_score: Square root of equal-season mean game-margin MSE
normalization: Center each component using common matched players and rated-season side-possession weights; missing coefficients remain zero
shared_nuisance_terms: Rated-season normal-RAPM home coefficient and intercept for every candidate
calibration: None applied; calibration slope is diagnostic only
darko_source: DARKO - Daily Adjusted and Regressed Kalman Optimized projections - Full DPM History.csv
reconstruction_policy: Use saved PIPM and RAPTOR as-is per user instruction. Pooled RAPTOR historical training is explicitly caveated; do not claim all comparators are past-only.
pending: Resolve current PULSE builder provenance and regenerate/check fold coefficient support as needed.
Score all main candidates on identical game keys and identical final player support with one explicit missing-player rule.
rules: Never use final-descriptive PULSE as historical out-of-time predictions.
PULSE prior target ends and training years must precede each rating year. RAPTOR is an as-is reconstructed comparator with pooled training, not a chronological validation claim.
Only rated-season data may enter the lineup update or season normalization.
Outcome year must equal rating year plus one; no 2027 outcomes.
Any calibration is fitted on earlier outcome years only.
Keep frozen model choices fixed; historical results are reused diagnostics, not untouched confirmation.
Label both CourtSignal reconstructions explicitly and do not attribute them to the source authors.
Do not merge shorter MAMBA coverage into the main ranking without a separate same-timespan panel.
Record input/code hashes, actual source dates, inclusion masks, missingness and exclusions before publication.
